description: Find company directory candidates using at most one of query, domain, ticker or identifier, or discover by country, an exact industry pair. Returns companies and an opaque next cursor without choosing a match. Deep belongs to each result. Keep the same selector, filters and limit when sending cursor. Empty listings do not establish private ownership.

authority.description: Issuing authority filter for identifier searches

country.description: ISO2 profile-country filter; does not mean headquarters or operating presence

cursor.description: Opaque next cursor returned by the same search

deep.description: Include the nested deep object when available. Pricing depends on the operation.

industry.description: Exact four-digit SIC code string, preserving leading zeros; requires industry_type

industry_type.description: Industry namespace; currently sic; requires industry

limit.description: Maximum candidates on this page, from 1 to 50

query.description: Company name search, sent as q

ticker.description: Security ticker, optionally scoped by exchange

name: company_search
title: Company Search
